image_description: A large, dark wood built-in bookcase spanning a wall in a room. The unit features multiple vertical sections with adjustable shelves filled with books and decorative items. The top section includes glass-fronted cabinets on the right side. A potted plant sits on top of the central section. To the left, a black chair and a framed picture are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rectangular furniture piece of considerable height, notably taller than wide.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The structure is clearly a tall, rectangular piece of furniture dominating the wall space.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tall rectangular frame with horizontal divisions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bookcase has a clear outer frame and distinct horizontal shelf lines dividing the space.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Bilateral symmetry with open front displaying books and objects.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the individual bays have symmetry, the overall unit is asymmetrical due to the different configurations (open shelves vs. glass cabinets) and the off-center plant.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Multiple horizontal shelves spaced evenly from top to bottom.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Numerous horizontal shelves are visible across all vertical sections, holding books.
Adjustability is an internal mechanism not visually verifiable from this distance/angle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Some models have glass doors on upper section.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The right-most vertical section clearly features glass-fronted cabinets with reflections visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Constructed from wood particleboard or metal with finished surface stained painted or laminated.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The material appears to be dark-stained wood with a smooth, finished surface consistent with furniture grade materials.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Front open displaying books and objects on each shelf.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Most sections are open-faced, revealing spines of books and various decorative objects.
Small knobs/handles are visible on the lower cabinet doors and glass cabinets; surfaces are uniformly finished.

artifact_observations.location: Book spines on middle and lower shelves
artifact_observations.reasoning: Text on book spines is largely illegible or nonsensical upon close inspection, typical of AI generation where fine text details fail to resolve correctly.

artifact_observations.location: Top right corner of the bookcase frame
artifact_observations.reasoning: The vertical stile on the far right seems to blend slightly into the ceiling/wall junction without a crisp edge, suggesting minor geometric ambiguity.

artifact_observations.location: Plant on top of the bookcase
artifact_observations.reasoning: The plant leaves lack distinct vein structures and appear somewhat 'melted' or overly smooth compared to real foliage, indicating texture synthesis issues.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a bookcase and not a similar storage unit like a shelving rack or cabinet.
To verify the 3D consistency of the shelves and ensure the glass doors have correct depth/reflection properties relative to the open shelves.
To check for boundary bleeding between adjacent books and the shelf edges, ensuring distinct object separation.
To assess general image coherence, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle global artifacts missed by specific audits.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of text on book spines
Geometric consistency of shelf depths and vertical alignments
Boundary sharpness between books and shelf backgrounds
Realism of the plant texture on top
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the book spines. While they look like books from a distance, AI often fails to render coherent text or consistent spine thicknesses. Check if the 'glass' doors actually show reflections consistent with the room's lighting or if they are just transparent overlays. Verify if the plant on top has a logical connection to the pot and realistic leaf geometry.
